description.zh:
已接入的资源ID，云产品接入时由WAF自动生成。

> 您可以通过[CreateCloudResource](~~2839876~~)接入资源后，查看响应中的资源ID。
description.en:
The ID of the connected resource, which is automatically generated by WAF in cloud native mode.

> You can connect a resource by calling [CreateCloudResource](~~2839876~~) and then view the resource ID in the response.

description.zh:
WAF实例的ID。

> 您可以调用[DescribeInstance](~~433756~~)查询当前WAF实例的ID。
description.en:
The ID of the WAF instance.

> You can call [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) to query the ID of the WAF instance.

description.zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

- **cn-hangzhou**：表示中国内地。

- **ap-southeast-1**：表示非中国内地。
description.en:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.
The Alibaba Cloud resource group ID.

title.zh: 修改云产品接入的配置
